topic: Asking How Spicy the Dish Is before Ordering

script.title: HOW SPICY IS IT
script.scene_zh: 餐館桌邊 · 點菜問辣
script.story_hook: Picking a dish means knowing the heat.
script.intro_zh: 挑一道菜，就得先搞懂它到底有多辣。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to tonight's restaurant table. Listen for asking about spice.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的餐廳餐桌場景。留意詢問辣度的說法。
script.outro: And that's a smart, spice-safe order. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一則又聰明又安全的辣度點餐就這樣完成。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: an older woman in her sixties with short silver hair, tortoiseshell glasses, a lavender cardigan over a soft blouse, a small handbag on her lap, and a slight stooped build
script.char_b_description: a young man in his twenties with shoulder-length dark hair tied back, a thin mustache, a black server apron over a grey shirt, an order pad in his pocket, and a tall lean build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, could you help me pick a dish?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjus mi kʊd ju hɛlp mi pɪk ə dɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，能幫我推薦一道菜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, are you eating in or taking out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ɑɹ ju ˈitɪŋ ɪn ɔɹ ˈteɪkɪŋ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你是在店內用還是外帶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dining in tonight, it's just me today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdaɪnɪŋ ɪn təˈnaɪt ɪts dʒʌst mi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚在店內吃，今天只有我一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let me walk you through the menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt mi wɔk ju θɹu ðə ˈmɛnju/
dialogue.zh: 那讓我帶你看一遍菜單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, half of these I can't read.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du hæf ʌv ðiz aɪ kænt rid/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，這裡面一半我都看不懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, fair, the handwriting is my chef's.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ ðə ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋ ɪz maɪ ʃɛfs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，正常，字都是主廚親筆寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what's the spiciest thing you serve?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wæts ðə ˈspaɪsiəst θɪŋ ju sɝv/
dialogue.zh: 那，菜單上最辣的是哪一道？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, the hot chicken is our famous one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə hɑt ˈtʃɪkən ɪz ɑɹ ˈfeɪməs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那道辣雞可是我們的招牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Famous is good, but is it truly hot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfeɪməs ɪz ɡʊd bʌt ɪz ɪt ˈtɹuli hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 招牌不錯，但它真的很辣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honest answer, yes, it clears both sinuses.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəst ˈænsɚ jɛs ɪt klɪɹz bɑθ ˈsaɪnəsəz/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，是的，辣到通鼻又流淚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, that sounds like a real challenge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ noʊ ðæt saʊndz laɪk ə ɹiəl ˈtʃæləndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那聽起來真是一場考驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, some folks order it for a dare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz səm foʊks ˈɔɹdɚ ɪt fɚ ə dɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，有些人專門點它來挑戰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't handle that, I'm not good with heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt ˈhændəl ðæt aɪm nɑt ɡʊd wɪð hit/
dialogue.zh: 那個我可應付不來，我吃辣很沒轍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, we've got mild and medium too.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝiz wiv ɡɑt maɪld ænd ˈmiːdiəm tu/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，還有微辣跟中辣可以選。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the gap between mild and medium?
dialogue.phonetic: /wæts ðə ɡæp bɪˈtwin maɪld ænd ˈmiːdiəm/
dialogue.zh: 那微辣跟中辣的差別在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mild is gentle, medium has a real kick.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪld ɪz ˈdʒɛntəl ˈmiːdiəm hæz ə ɹiəl kɪk/
dialogue.zh: 微辣很溫和，中辣有一點真正的後勁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, a gentle kick might be okay for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ə ˈdʒɛntəl kɪk maɪt bi ˌoʊˈkeɪ fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，一點溫柔的後勁我應該受得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then medium, but I'll ask for a light one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈmiːdiəm bʌt aɪl æsk fɚ ə laɪt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那就中辣，不過我會請廚房做輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, you can adjust that? That's handy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ ju kæn əˈdʒʌst ðæt ðæts ˈhændi/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這樣也能調整嗎？真方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the kitchen can set the heat for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ðə ˈkɪtʃən kæn sɛt ðə hit fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 可以，廚房會照你的要求調辣度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, because I do hate a watery mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd bɪˈkɔz aɪ du heɪt ə ˈwɔɾəɹi mɛs/
dialogue.zh: 好，因為我最討厭一片湯湯水水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, me too, we keep it saucy but clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ mi tu wi kip ɪt ˈsɔsi bʌt klin/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我也一樣，我們的醬給得夠，但不會亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, can you serve the sauce on the side?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt kæn ju sɝv ðə sɔs ɑn ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 等等，可以把醬另外裝在小碟裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, then you control every dip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli ðɛn ju kənˈtɹol ˈɛvɹi dɪp/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這樣要蘸多少醬，都由你控制。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's exactly what I was hoping for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ wəz ˈhoʊpɪŋ fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這正是我一直在期待的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart way to ease into medium heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt weɪ tə iz ˈɪntə ˈmiːdiəm hit/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這樣就能慢慢進到中辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, um, do you sprinkle pepper flakes free?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ʌm du ju ˈspɪŋkəl ˈpɛpɚ fleɪks fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 那，嗯，辣椒片是免費隨便拿的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they're on the counter, take a shaker.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɹz ɑn ðə ˈkaʊnɾɚ teɪk ə ˈʃeɪkɚ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，就放在檯面上，自己拿一瓶吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, I'll just add a pinch myself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ naɪs aɪl dʒʌst æd ə pɪntʃ maɪˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 噢真好，那我就自己撒一小撮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that keeps things fair for both of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðæt kipz θɪŋz fɛɹ fɚ bɑθ ʌv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 完美，這樣你我就都剛剛好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And is the rice plain or seasoned here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪz ðə ɹaɪs pleɪn ɔɹ ˈsizənd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 還有，這裡的飯是白飯還是調過味的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain by default, we salt only on request.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn baɪ dɪˈfɔlt wi sɑlt ˈonli ɑn ɹɪˈkwɛst/
dialogue.zh: 預設是白飯，只有在要求時才會加鹽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plain is best, it cools my mouth down.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn ɪz bɛst ɪt kulz maɪ maʊθ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 白飯最好，能幫嘴巴降辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good instinct, rice beats bread for a burning tongue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈɪnˌstɪŋkt ɹaɪs bits bɹɛd fɚ ə ˈbɝnɪŋ tʌŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好直覺，舌頭燒起來時飯比麵包管用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, noted, my bread's already half gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊtɪd maɪ bɹɛdz ɔlˈrɛdi hæf ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，記下了，我的麵包已經吃掉一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want a refill on that warm bread?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ə ɹɪˈfɪl ɑn ðæt wɔɹm bɹɛd/
dialogue.zh: 要不要再補一份那個溫熱麵包？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, could I get just one extra roll?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl kʊd aɪ ɡɛt dʒʌst wʌn ˈɛkstɹə ɹoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 那個，能只要多一份小餐包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One roll, and water or something else?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɹoʊl ænd ˈwɔɾɚ ɔɹ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 一份餐包，喝的還要白開水還是別的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just water, um, with ice if that's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈwɔɾɚ ʌm wɪθ aɪs ɪf ðæts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 只要白開水就好，嗯，加個冰塊可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice water, coming right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs ˈwɔɾɚ ˈkʌmɪŋ ɹaɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 加冰的水，馬上幫你送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Is there shrimp in the chicken?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ɪz ðɛɹ ʃɹimp ɪn ðə ˈtʃɪkən/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。這道雞肉裡有放蝦子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, unless you want it without the shellfish.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌnˈlɛs ju wɑnt ɪt wɪˈðaʊt ðə ˈʃɛlfɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，除非你想把海鮮拿掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, one shrimp is fine, I'm not allergic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ wʌn ʃɹimp ɪz faɪn aɪm nɑt əˈlɝdʒɪk/
dialogue.zh: 噢，一隻蝦沒關係，我對海鮮不過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, then the medium plate works perfectly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ðɛn ðə ˈmiːdiəm pleɪt wɝks ˈpɝfəktli/
dialogue.zh: 好，那就中辣那一盤最適合你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. And a spoon too, if I may?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ænd ə spun tu ɪf aɪ meɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。可以再給我一支湯匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Certainly, a spoon for all the extra sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɝtnli ə spun fɔɹ ɔl ði ˈɛkstrə sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 當然，給你一支舀醬用的湯匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, I might need a second napkin soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aɪ maɪt nid ə ˈsɛkənd ˈnæpkɪn sun/
dialogue.zh: 正是，我大概很快就要再多一張餐巾紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, the medium usually wins that round.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə ˈmiːdiəm ˈjuʒəwəli wɪnz ðæt ɹaʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，通常都是中辣贏得這一回合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, if it's too hot, can I downgrade?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪf ɪts tu hɑt kæn aɪ ˈdaʊnɡɹeɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，要是真的太辣，我能換低一點的辣度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I'll swap you to mild, no charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs aɪl swɑp ju tə maɪld noʊ tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我幫你換成微辣，不收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me brave enough to try it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks mi bɹeɪv ɪˈnʌf tə traɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這樣就有勇氣試著吃看看了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the spirit, we'll keep the mild ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈspɪɹɪt wil kip ðə maɪld ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 就是要這樣，我會先備一份微辣給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful. And roughly how long till the plate?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfʌl ænd ˈɹʌfli haʊ lɔŋ tɪl ðə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那大約幾分鐘能上那一盤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes, the chicken needs a quick sear.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈmɪnəts ðə ˈtʃɪkən nidz ə kwɪk sɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 十二分鐘，雞肉需要快煎一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve is fine, I'm in no rush tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ɪz faɪn aɪm ɪn noʊ ɹʌʃ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 十二分鐘沒問題，我今晚不趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, take your time with that bread.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd teɪk jɔɹ taɪm wɪð ðæt bɹɛd/
dialogue.zh: 好，那就慢慢享用你的麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, this was a lot of questions, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɪs wəz ə lɑt ʌv ˈkwɛstʃənz ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 唉，我問了超多問題，真不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, I like a careful guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈæt ˈɔl aɪ laɪk ə ˈkɛɹfʊl ɡɛst/
dialogue.zh: 哪有，我最喜歡這樣仔細問的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's kind, thanks for guiding my order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts kaɪnd θæŋks fɔɹ ˈɡaɪdɪŋ maɪ ˈɔɹdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你真好，謝謝你一路幫我點菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure, I'll send your water first.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʃɚ aɪl sɛnd jɔɹ ˈwɔɾɚ fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，我會先把你的水送來。

script.youtube_title: 【到店點菜先問辣度🌶️】「專門點它來挑戰」😮教你用英文問清微辣中辣與醬料🥣｜聽完就能自己點｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜How Spicy Is It
script.youtube_title_en: "Order It for a Dare" — Asking How Spicy a Dish Is before You Order
script.youtube_description:
「有些人專門點它來挑戰」——坐在餐館桌邊，想吃得安心又過癮，該怎麼用英文把每道菜的辣度問清楚？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在一位客人跟服務生來回確認辣度的點餐過程。

你會聽到：請服務生帶看菜單、追問最辣的是哪一道、搞懂微辣與中辣的後勁差別；當自己吃不辣時怎麼請廚房做輕一點、怎麼把醬另外裝在小碟；還有辣椒片免費拿、白飯還是調味飯、溫熱麵包與冰水、蝦子海鮮過敏，以及太辣時換成微辣不收錢的實用說法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人餐廳點餐的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、oh、hmm。聽完你就會用：could you help me...、can you serve the sauce on the side?、if it's too hot, can I...、I'll swap you to mild。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Some folks order it for a dare" — sitting at a restaurant table, how do you ask in English exactly how spicy each dish really is before you commit? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around one diner and one server talking through the heat.

You will hear: asking the server to walk you through the menu, pressing on the spiciest plate, and learning the gap between mild and medium; ordering a lighter version when you're not good with heat, and getting the sauce on the side; plus free pepper flakes, plain versus seasoned rice, warm bread and ice water, the shrimp on the plate, and swapping to mild at no charge if it burns.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the real table talk Americans use: um, well, so, ha, oh, hmm. By the end you'll own phrases like can you serve the sauce on the side?, if it's too hot can I..., and I'll swap you to mild.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
看著菜單卻看不懂辣度，微辣跟中辣差多少？要是怕辣，能不能請廚房做輕一點，或把醬另外裝？太辣時還來得及換嗎？

這一集帶大家坐進一間餐館，陪一位客人跟服務生逐道確認辣度，從最辣的招牌、後勁的差別，一路聽到醬料另裝、辣椒片、白飯配冰水與太辣就換微辣，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🌶️ 追問句：So, what's the spiciest thing you serve?
🥣 調整句：Wait, can you serve the sauce on the side?
🧂 配料句：Now, um, do you sprinkle pepper flakes free?
🔥 保險句：Well, if it's too hot, can I downgrade?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、hmm 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這桌點菜走一遍，下次坐進餐廳，你就能從容問清楚辣度。

祝你下一餐，辣得剛剛好。
